name: price_momentum
notes: Dollar change, not a return: a $500 stock outranks a $20 stock for arithmetic reasons. Compare with momentum_oscillator, its scale-free twin.

name: volume_momentum
notes: Share-count change; dominated by large-float names.

name: roc
notes: Algebraically identical to momentum_oscillator below; A.3 lists both.

name: macd_momentum
notes: MACD is an EMA difference in dollars, so it scales with price.

name: momentum_oscillator
notes: Identical expression to roc. Kept so the category count matches A.3, but a 'diversified' selection picking both is picking one factor twice.

name: dpo
notes: The worked example in A.1/Figure 4. Dollar-denominated.

name: mean_reversion
notes: MEAN and SMA are the same operator, so this is identical to ma_reversion.

name: bollinger_position
notes: k=2.0 on a 20-day SMA (A.3 does not state the band width).

name: keltner_position
notes: EMA(20) centre with 2x ATR(10) bands; A.3 specifies neither.

name: percent_b
notes: bollinger_position times 100 -- an identical ranking, listed twice by A.3.

name: std_dev
notes: Dollar standard deviation; higher-priced stocks rank higher mechanically.

name: garman_klass
notes: A.3 gives no window, so this is a single-bar estimator and is correspondingly noisy; convention averages the variance over ~20 days first.

name: yang_zhang
notes: Transcribed as written; this is NOT the canonical Yang-Zhang estimator (no k-weighting, no Rogers-Satchell term). VAR window set to 20 days.

name: price_to_earnings
notes: TTM diluted EPS, known from its SEC filing date. Undefined/negative for loss-makers, which is why earnings_yield is the more usable form.

name: price_to_book
notes: Uses book value PER SHARE: A.3's CLOSE/BOOK_VALUE mixes a per-share price with a company-level total and is not a P/B ratio as written.

name: dividend_yield
notes: TTM declared dividends per share.

name: earnings_yield
notes: Reciprocal of price_to_earnings, but better behaved: it stays finite and correctly ordered through zero earnings.

name: sales_to_price
notes: Revenue per share over price (see price_to_book note on units).

name: cash_flow_yield
notes: Operating cash flow per share over price.

name: obv
notes: Unbounded cumulative sum with no window, exactly as A.3 writes it; its level depends on how long the name has been listed.

name: amihud_illiquidity
notes: A.3 divides by share volume; Amihud's own measure uses dollar volume.

name: dollar_volume
notes: A near-pure size proxy: ranks megacaps top every day.

name: debt_to_equity_liq
notes: A.3 lists debt-to-equity under both Liquidity and Quality.

name: gross_profit_margin_liq
notes: Repeated verbatim in the Quality block.

name: bid_ask_spread
notes: Needs quote-level (NBBO) data. Daily OHLCV cannot supply it, and no free intraday quote source is reachable here, so it is excluded rather than approximated by a high-low proxy that would double-count the high_low_spread factor already in this category.

name: earnings_stability
notes: Window read as five reporting periods (315 trading days), not five days: five daily bars of a quarterly TTM series have zero variance.

name: interest_coverage
notes: EBIT proxied by operating income. Interest expense is untagged by many filers, so coverage is thin.

name: cash_conversion_cycle
notes: DIO=365*inventory/COGS, DSO=365*receivables/revenue, DPO=365*payables/COGS. Meaningless for financials, which carry no inventory.

name: earnings_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: revenue_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: ebitda_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: cash_flow_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: dividends_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: book_value_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: sales_growth
notes: A.3 lists SALES and REVENUE growth separately; both resolve to the same XBRL revenue concept.

name: asset_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: equity_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: retained_earnings_growth
notes: DELAY(X,1) read as one year (252 trading days) of the TTM series.

name: moving_average
notes: A price level. Cross-sectionally this ranks stocks by nominal share price and essentially nothing else.

name: exp_moving_average
notes: See moving_average.

name: bollinger_bands
notes: Raw band span in dollars (= 4 * STD(CLOSE,20)); monotone in std_dev.

name: atr_technical
notes: A.3 lists ATR(14) under both Volatility and Technical.

name: interest_rate
notes: 10-year Treasury yield (^TNX), n=21 trading days. Cross-sectionally constant: contributes nothing to a stock ranking.

name: short_rate
notes: 13-week T-bill (^IRX). Stands in for A.3's separate macro entries that require FRED. Cross-sectionally constant.

name: implied_vol_change
notes: VIX change, used as the reachable stand-in for A.3's Consumer Confidence Index. Cross-sectionally constant.

name: dollar_index_change
notes: Dollar index (DXY) change, proxying A.3's FX reserves. Cross-sectionally constant.

name: oil_price_change
notes: Crude oil, proxying industrial production. Cross-sectionally constant.

name: gold_price_change
notes: Gold, proxying inflation. Cross-sectionally constant.

name: gdp_growth
notes: FRED GDPC1 unreachable from this environment. Would in any case be cross-sectionally constant.

name: unemployment_rate
notes: FRED UNRATE unreachable. Would in any case be cross-sectionally constant.

name: retail_sales_growth
notes: FRED RSAFS unreachable. Would in any case be cross-sectionally constant.

name: housing_starts_growth
notes: FRED HOUST unreachable. Would in any case be cross-sectionally constant.
